description: Use this when a homeowner wants a checklist for comparing written bids for their home job. Do not use this to estimate a job’s cost or choose a contractor for them. Use this when comparing written contractor bids for any home trade. Get six items to compare and optional trade-specific preparation. The trade enum selects the checklists we have; it does not limit which home jobs InstaBids accepts. Omit trade for the general checklist; the answer's trade is then null. The answer includes sourceUrl.

trade.description: optional trade key; leave it out for the general six items; the answer's trade is null when none was given

name: bid_checklist
title: Bid comparison checklist
